# RCP — REST Connector Protocol

> A lightweight, open protocol for exposing REST APIs as AI-callable tools — without running a protocol server. If MCP is the right fit when you need rich, stateful capabilities, RCP is for the much more common case: you already have a REST API, and you just want an AI application to be able to call some of its endpoints as tools.

RCP (REST Connector Protocol) is an open standard and TypeScript SDK for turning existing REST APIs into AI-callable tools. A server publishes a plain JSON manifest at a URL. A client fetches it, builds callable tools from it, and calls the endpoints it describes directly — no JSON-RPC, no persistent connection, no protocol server.

## Key concepts

- **Manifest**: A JSON document at a URL describing available tools, their parameters, HTTP methods, URL templates, auth requirements, and response mappings.
- **Client**: Fetches manifests, renders URL templates, injects auth/resolvers, calls endpoints, and maps responses.
- **Server**: Exposes REST endpoints and publishes an RCP manifest via `defineTool()`.
- **Resolvers**: Client-side-only values (like API keys or user IDs) that are injected at call time and never sent to the model.
- **Auth**: Supports `none`, `header`, and (specified but not yet implemented) `oauth2`.

## SDK

`rcp-sdk` is published on npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/rcp-sdk

### Entry points

- `rcp-sdk/client` — `createRcpClient()`, `discover()`, `call()`, `describeManifest()`
- `rcp-sdk/server` — `defineTool()`, `t.arg()` for building manifests from zod schemas
- `rcp-sdk/adapters/openai` — Convert RCP tools to OpenAI function-calling format
- `rcp-sdk/adapters/langchain` — Convert RCP tools to LangChain `DynamicStructuredTool` instances
- `rcp-sdk/adapters/gemini` — Convert RCP tools to Google GenAI (Gemini) format (Interactions API + classic)

### Install

```bash
npm install rcp-sdk
# or
pnpm add rcp-sdk
```

## Examples

- `examples/express` — Express REST API serving an RCP manifest
- `examples/openai-client` — Interactive CLI chat with OpenAI + RCP tools
- `examples/langchain-client` — Interactive CLI chat with LangChain + RCP tools
- `examples/gemini-client` — Interactive CLI chat with Gemini + RCP tools
